description: Original -> Grammarly-accepted rewrite pairs, collected live from app.grammarly.com on 2026-08-29 by typing each sentence into their editor and accepting every suggestion Grammarly offered. "changed: false" means Grammarly offered nothing (or nothing that altered the sentence) - these are true negatives and are as valuable as the rewrites.
method: Sentences typed in batches of 10; every suggestion card accepted via real clicks; final document text read back and split with our own segmenter; pairs aligned by index. Tone-suggestion cards (a separate Grammarly feature, not clarity) were dismissed, not accepted.
caveats: Document language was British English, so a few edits are en-GB spelling normalisations (analyse, socialise, operationalise, summarises) rather than clarity edits.
Where Grammarly offered several mutually exclusive fixes for one span, accepting sequentially applies the first offered; alternatives are not captured here.
One observed Grammarly error is preserved verbatim in the data: "a brand new innovation" -> "a brand innovation".
